preconditions.description: The dimensions of the matrix w are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All elements of the matrix w are within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or starts with 'YES' followed by the required values.
If the output is 'YES', the value of k is within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('YES\n') implies all(0 <= ai <= 10**18 for ai in a)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', all elements of array a are within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('YES\n') implies all(0 <= bi <= 10**18 for bi in b)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', all elements of array b are within the specified range.

postconditions.expression: return_value.startswith('YES\n') implies all(w[i][j] == (a[i] + b[j]) % k for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the matrix w can be reconstructed using the given k, a, and b.
